A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: Ip Man: The Final Fight
programme.desc: Legendary Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man finds himself drawn into dangerous underworld of the Triads. In order to defend life and honor, he has no choice but to fight one last time.

programme.title: The Lingering

Is it a ghost or is there something more earthly to explain the strange occurrences?

programme.desc: Organized crime in America has a long and sordid history that can be traced back to street gangs of the 1800s. The violent and corruption escalated and captured the attention of the nation during the Prohibition Era when Lucky Luciano, John Dillinger, Baby Face Nelson, Bugsy Siegel and Al Capone became household names. The Mafia’s influence has infiltrated big business and politics while being a permanent area of focus for law enforcement and the media alike. This fascinating investigative documentary series explores the history of organized crime and the most notable players in evolving empire of evil.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Uncovering the stories behind some of Australia’s finest architectural designs, we learn how a holiday ho use was built on Stradbroke Island to retain the connection to nature that camping brings, and we go bush in southern Tasmania to see how a rich heritage of architecturally designed , eco-tourism walker accommodation has been built on .

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Uncovering the stories behind some of Australia’s finest architectural designs, we learn how Australian design has infused the headquarters of the American Australian Association in New York, how an innovative use of material and organic forms is luring people back in to the workplace, and we reveal our Commentator’s Choice of the series.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: In this episode, we finally count down the best of the best in Australian architecture. Our judges and experts have come together to share with you the top 10 architectural feats of Series 1. Make sure you stick around to find out who the winner is!

programme.title: Hotels ByDesign
programme.desc: In this series, our ByDesign team discover some of the most impressive designed hotels in America and beyond. This episode we explore the Hard Rock Hotel in New York with the designer Jeffrey Beers, Mike travels to Mexico to the remarkable Las Ventanas Al Paraíso, two hotel offerings in one in Austin Texas with the Tommy and the Thompson, the Shinola Hotel in Detroit and The Redline Inn in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, where they celebrate Norman Rockwell’s famous painting every Christmas.

programme.title: Hotels ByDesign
programme.desc: In this episode, the Edgewood Tahoe Resort on the shores of Lake Tahoe in Nevada, we travel to Orlando to experience two hotels – the Lake Nona Wave & Four Seasons Orlando. Renowned French lighting designer Herve Descottes visits Saint Kate - The Arts Hotel in Milwaukee, Mike travels to Dubai to the Mandarin Oriental Jumeira, and we deep dive on the design intent of the Omni Boston Hotel at the Seaport.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: With space at a premium in the most populated area of Australia, designers and architects have had to be creative in their use of space to maximise a buildings potential, whether it’s a holiday home, childcare facility or downtown restaurant. Watch as we count down the best buildings in New South Wales and the Australian Capital territory.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Queensland, Australia is known as the tropical region of the country, which brings its challenges when it comes to designing a home. Watch us countdown ten of the best ways architects have worked around these limitations to create something fresh and new to this difficult environment.

programme.title: The Travelling Chef
programme.desc: Brett is invited to the beautiful Malaysian island of Langkawi by a local chef who is looking for some new recipes for his seafood restaurant. In return, Brett wants to learn from him his version of Nasi Lemak. Brett catches his own fish from a fish farm before showing the chef a dish he learnt in Thailand from episode one. Brett learns from the chef how to create Nasi Lemak and discovers other versions of the dish whilst on the island.

programme.title: The Travelling Chef
programme.desc: Brett visits China Town in Singapore to see how the vendors make dumplings and noodles. He then goes to the At-Sunrice Global Chef Academy and learns in a class from a master in dumpling making.

programme.title: America ByDesign Innovations
programme.desc: As we continue our search for the best innovative design in America, our judges will fill the remaining two spots left in our top ten for the year. Amongst the 6 designs up for consideration we discover digital design that’s used in Hollywood movies, IBM shows us how to design for racial equity, and we see a new kitchen measuring cup that’s so simple it’s hard to believe no one has thought of it before!

programme.title: America ByDesign Innovations
programme.desc: It's time for the Best-of-the-Best! Join us as we revisit the Top Ten Innovation and countdown to reveal the ultimate winner of the season!

programme.title: California ByDesign Innovations
programme.desc: Our search for the best innovations continues! This episode showcases 7 amazing Innovations including a new portable BBQ, a training device for surgeons, and a vacuum comb for headlice.

programme.title: California ByDesign Innovations
programme.desc: In this episode of California ByDesign, we showcase a space exploration lander for NASA, a new aid for meditation and a modular backpack and much more.

programme.title: Homemade Modern
programme.desc: This alloy is made from Tin and Bismuth, contains no lead and melts at around 280 degrees Fahrenheit. programme.title: Homemade Modern
programme.desc: Woodworking with LEGO! I have used Lego bricks as design and prototyping tools for a long time, but typically I use them for casting concrete or mold making. programme.title: Homemade Modern
programme.desc: I made a DIY workout bench that goes from flat to a 30-degree incline in just 34 seconds. This is part of my DIY plywood home gym set up and this bench is an easy woodworking project that can be made with basic power tools.

programme.title: Homemade Modern
programme.desc: I used rock tumblers to make sea glass. Tumbling glass in a rock tumbler allows you to make your sea glass in 3-5 days.
